scope: Typed exact-key lookups only. Apply the previously tested whole-record selection on Coder-14B after a simulated tool returns its complete 58- or 83-record JSON. Same reader and new arrival waves as the scheduling holdout, fixed stock policy, no retained prefix. This workload has no external tool/network execution.
design: One new server per GPU. Run both input forms for each of the 8 original cells. Alternate which form runs first on successive cells; reverse this order between physical GPUs. All 136 final returns and 32 reference readers are counted. Selection, parsing, serialization, HTTP and generation are included from the scheduled return instant.
gates: Check source record identities and all fields, wire payload and prompt identity for each arm; require both source amounts on all terminals, reader output IDs preserved between arms, full result identical to previous stock responses. Dispatch error <=15ms, >0 real overlaps per wave. On both GPUs require >=20% improvement of first- and last-visible p95, no more than 5% loss on reader TPOT median or inter-content p95. Also publish actual output lengths and per-wave worst completion. No policy inference from arbitrary natural-language queries.
